from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
stream = io.StringIO()
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(
    str(root / "tests/control_center"),
    pattern="test_control_center.py",
)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2).run(suite)
log = stream.getvalue()
issues = []
for test, tb in list(result.failures) + list(result.errors):
    issues.append({
        "test": str(test),
        "traceback": tb,
    })
summary = {
    "tests_run": result.testsRun,
    "failures": len(result.failures),
    "errors": len(result.errors),
    "successful": result.wasSuccessful(),
    "first_issue": issues[0] if issues else None,
}
out = root / "diagnostic-result"
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out / "control-center-e006-test-diagnostic.json").write_text(
    json.dumps({"summary": summary, "full_log": log, "issues": issues}, indent=2),
    encoding="utf-8",
)
print("CONTROL_CENTER_E006_DIAG " + json.dumps(summary, separators=(",", ":")), flush=True)
if issues:
    print("FIRST_TRACEBACK_BEGIN", flush=True)
    print(issues[0]["traceback"][-12000:], flush=True)
    print("FIRST_TRACEBACK_END", flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0)
